# DWM Compressor

> DWM Compressor (https://compressor.dealwithmuhammad.com) is a free online compressor that runs entirely in the web browser: it compresses PDFs by quality or to an exact target size (for example under 100 KB), compresses JPG, PNG, WebP and iPhone HEIC images (also to a target size such as 50 KB), converts HEIC to JPG, and compresses video to MP4 or WebM with ffmpeg.wasm. Files are processed on the user's own device and never uploaded; there is no sign-up, no watermark, no paid tier and no file-size limit. It was built by Muhammad Ahmad, a web and mobile app developer in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Last updated October 2026.

## Pages

- [Compress PDF, images & video online](https://compressor.dealwithmuhammad.com/): the full tool, opening on PDF compression
- [Compress PDF to 100 KB](https://compressor.dealwithmuhammad.com/compress-pdf-to-100kb): PDF tool preset to a 100 KB target at Low resolution, for job, exam and visa portals
- [Compress images online](https://compressor.dealwithmuhammad.com/compress-image): JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC compression preset to 70% quality and 2000px
- [Compress JPEG to 50 KB](https://compressor.dealwithmuhammad.com/compress-jpeg-to-50kb): image tool preset to a 50 KB JPG target, for application photos and signatures
- [HEIC to JPG converter](https://compressor.dealwithmuhammad.com/heic-to-jpg): converts iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos to JPG (or PNG, WebP, PDF) in the browser
- [Compress video online](https://compressor.dealwithmuhammad.com/compress-video): MP4/MOV/MKV and more to MP4 (H.264) or WebM (VP9), with 720p/480p options

## What it does

- **Compress PDF** — by quality (30–90%) or to a target size in KB or MB (for example 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB or 1 MB), at Low, Medium or High resolution. Each page is re-rendered with pdf.js, re-encoded as a JPEG and rebuilt into a new PDF with pdf-lib. In target-size mode it automatically searches for the highest quality that fits under the target.
- **Compress images** — JPG, PNG, WebP and iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos, by quality or target size, optionally resized to a maximum of 2000px or 1280px, saved as JPG or WebP. In target-size mode it lowers quality first and then shrinks the dimensions if needed.
- **Compress video** — accepts MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WebM, M4V, 3GP, FLV, WMV, MPEG/MPG, TS, M2TS, OGV and most other formats. Outputs MP4 (H.264 video, AAC audio) or WebM (VP9 video, Opus audio). Options: compression strength (CRF 20–34) and resolution (keep, 720p or 480p). Uses ffmpeg.wasm; the ~31 MB engine downloads once, on first use.
- **Convert** — HEIC/HEIF to JPG; images to JPG, PNG or WebP; many images combined into one PDF (one image per page); a PDF into JPG images (one per page, as a ZIP).
- **PDF tools** — select and extract pages into a new PDF (with page thumbnails), add a password to a PDF, or remove a password you already know.
- **Convenience** — batch processing of many files at once, paste files from the clipboard, download results one by one or all together as a ZIP, light/dark theme, and installable as a Progressive Web App.
- **Chrome extension** — a small extension that opens DWM Compressor from the browser toolbar or the right-click menu.

## Privacy

- All processing happens locally in the browser. Files, file names and file contents are never uploaded to any server.
- The site records anonymous page views and which tool was used (for example "compress-pdf") — never anything about the files themselves.
- No account, no sign-up, no watermark.

## Limits

- No file-size or file-count limit is imposed by the tool. The practical limit is the device's memory; very large files, especially multi-gigabyte videos, may not fit in the browser's memory.
- PDF compression rasterises pages: text becomes part of the page image, so it is no longer selectable or searchable. It gives the biggest savings on scanned and image-heavy PDFs; text-only PDFs may not shrink much.
- If a target size can't be reached, the smallest version it could produce is returned; choosing Low resolution helps.
- Sizes use 1 KB = 1,024 bytes (100 KB = 102,400 bytes). For portals that count 1 KB as 1,000 bytes, aim slightly lower (e.g. 95 KB).
- Compressed and converted images do not keep EXIF metadata (camera, date, GPS location).
- Video compression is CPU-intensive and slower on phones and older computers. There is no target-size mode for video.
- Requires a modern browser with JavaScript and WebAssembly (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari — desktop or mobile).

## How to compress a PDF

1. Open the PDF tab and drop one or more PDFs onto the page, click to browse, or paste with Ctrl/⌘+V.
2. Choose "By quality" and set the slider (60% is a good balance), or choose "Target size" and enter a size such as 200 KB or 1 MB. Pick Low, Medium or High resolution.
3. Click Compress, then download each file or all of them as a ZIP.

## FAQ

- **Is DWM Compressor free?** Yes — completely free, with no sign-up, no watermark and no daily limit.
- **Are my files uploaded?** No. Everything runs in your browser with pdf.js, pdf-lib and ffmpeg.wasm, so your files never leave your device.
- **How do I compress a PDF to 100KB or 200KB?** In the PDF tab choose "Target size", enter 100 or 200 and select KB, then click Compress. If a large PDF can't get that small, set Resolution to Low and try again.
- **Does compressing a PDF reduce quality?** Somewhat: pages are re-rendered as images at the quality and resolution you choose, and text is no longer selectable. 60% quality at Medium resolution is a good balance.
- **Can I convert HEIC to JPG?** Yes. In the Convert tab choose Images, then JPG (or PNG/WebP), and add .heic/.heif photos. You can also combine photos into a PDF.
- **Is there a file-size limit?** No limit is set by the tool; only your device's memory limits very large files.
- **Does it work on a phone?** Yes, in modern mobile browsers on iPhone and Android, and it can be added to the home screen like an app.
- **Can I compress a JPEG to 50 KB?** Yes. In the Images tab choose "Target size", enter 50 and select KB. It lowers quality first and only shrinks the dimensions if needed.
- **How is it different from Smallpdf or iLovePDF?** Those services offer many more PDF tools and process files on their servers. DWM Compressor runs entirely in the browser with no account, paid tier or daily limit; the trade-off is that PDF pages become images, so text is not selectable afterwards.
- **Who made it?** Muhammad Ahmad, a web and mobile app developer in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
